direction.reference_meaning: Centre XY of the saved Wrist_bridge_plate bounding box, lower mounting face Z; a mechanical reference, not an anatomical rotation centre.
direction.interpretation: Tip moves toward wrist in hand-longitudinal projection and slightly closer to mounting reference. It does not directly point at the wrist.

kinematic_design.status: FORM002 preserved form rebuilt for gesture and fabrication checks; no manufacturing approval
kinematic_design.provenance: Anatomy-derived finger links, user-directed palm extension 127 to 150 mm and thumb links shortened to 65/50 mm. Mesh transforms are frozen here; pin holes and shells require CAD rebuilding.
kinematic_design.coordinates: Design/STL in millimetres, preview.xml body positions in metres. +Y toward fingertips, +Z palm-facing, +X index side. STL coordinates are joint-local, not assembled world coordinates.
kinematic_design.acceptance_scope: Form approximately accepted; webcam jitter/transitions rejected. No collision, strength, actuation or manufacturability acceptance.
kinematic_design.fist_path_scope: 33 authored visual poses; not measured tracking or collision evidence

gesture_candidate_pose_catalog.reference_fields_notice: Top-level fist_deg/fist_path remain the original accepted FORM002 reference. Current target gestures and candidate paths are defined separately in poses.json.

scope: All349 native saved STEP parts, same-body pairs included, no exclusions. One forward finger-closing path with thumb fixed, then thumb IP0 to -15. Representative mode reruns only selected existing samples. No reverse, continuous-clearance, hardware or speed approval.

assembly_roundtrip.identity_scope: Independent named STEP is canonical; assembly order, volume and bounds checked
